description: This file defines the TlsClientConnectionMiddleware class, which manages TLS client connections, including certificate validation, SSL stream setup, and connection handling within the Orleans framework.

classes.name: TlsClientConnectionMiddleware
classes.description: Middleware class for managing TLS client connections, including certificate validation, SSL stream setup, and connection lifecycle management.

methods.name: TlsClientConnectionMiddleware
methods.description: Constructor initializing the middleware with connection delegate, TLS options, and logger factory.

methods.name: OnConnectionAsync
methods.description: Starts processing a new connection asynchronously.

methods.name: InnerOnConnectionAsync
methods.description: Performs the core logic for handling a TLS connection, including setting up SSL stream, validation, and invoking the next middleware.

methods.name: ValidateCertificate
methods.description: Validates the provided certificate based on the remote certificate mode.

methods.name: EnsureCertificateIsAllowedForClientAuth
methods.description: Checks if a certificate is allowed for client authentication, throws if invalid.

methods.name: ConvertToX509Certificate2
methods.description: Converts an X509Certificate to X509Certificate2 if necessary.
